{"cmd": "python - <<'PY'\nimport json\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nwf_path = Path('/mnt/private/workspace/wzy/data/comfyui/user/default/workflows/qwen.json')\nwf = json.loads(wf_path.read_text())\n\nlink_map = {int(l[0]): (int(l[1]), int(l[2])) for l in wf.get('links', [])}\n\ndef _matches(expected, v):\n    if expected == 'INT':\n        return isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool)\n    if expected == 'FLOAT':\n        return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool)\n    if expected in ('COMBO', 'STRING'):\n        return isinstance(v, str)\n    if expected == 'BOOLEAN':\n        return isinstance(v, bool)\n    return True\n\n\ndef _consume(widgets, idx, expected):\n    while idx < len(widgets) and expected and not _matches(expected, widgets[idx]):\n        idx += 1\n    if idx >= len(widgets):\n        raise RuntimeError(f'No widget value for expected={expected} widgets={widgets}')\n    return widgets[idx], idx + 1\n\nprompt = {}\nfor node in wf.get('nodes', []):\n    node_id = str(node['id'])\n    class_type = node['type']\n    inputs = {}\n    widgets = list(node.get('widgets_values') or [])\n    widx = 0\n    for inp in node.get('inputs', []):\n        name = inp['name']\n        link = inp.get('link')\n        if link is not None:\n            o_id, o_slot = link_map[int(link)]\n            inputs[name] = [str(o_id), int(o_slot)]\n        else:\n            if 'widget' in inp:\n                expected = inp.get('type')\n                val, widx = _consume(widgets, widx, expected)\n                inputs[name] = val\n    prompt[node_id] = {'class_type': class_type, 'inputs': inputs}\n\nout_path = Path('/mnt/private/workspace/wzy/data/comfyui/artifacts/qwen_api_prompt.json')\nout_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\nout_path.write_text(json.dumps(prompt, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\\n')\nprint('wrote', out_path)\nPY"}

{"patch": "*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md\n+# RAM ↔ VRAM Offload Notes (ComfyUI)\n+\n+Goal: optimize **RAM→VRAM (H2D)** weight transfers for offload, and avoid doing\n+**VRAM→RAM (D2H)** writeback when CPU already has a weight copy.\n+\n+This repo contains a ComfyUI patch that changes the offload behavior to:\n+\n+1. Keep a **persistent CPU weight store** per module (optionally pinned).\n+2. On unload, **drop VRAM weights** and swap pointers back to the CPU store\n+   (**no D2H copy**).\n+\n+---\n+\n+## What Changed\n+\n+### 1) Persistent CPU store (torch pinned allocator, not host-register)\n+\n+- File: `comfy/pinned_memory.py`\n+- When a module is still on CPU, we allocate a flat `uint8` store via\n+  `torch.empty(..., pin_memory=True)` (unless `--disable-pinned-memory`).\n+- We copy the module’s **direct parameters** into this store once (CPU→CPU),\n+  then point parameters to CPU **views** backed by the store.\n+\n+Why this matters:\n+\n+- Baseline ComfyUI pins via `cudaHostRegister/Unregister` very frequently (per\n+  swap). That overhead can be multiple seconds per prompt in heavy offload\n+  workloads.\n+- Pinned allocations from PyTorch’s pinned allocator are already page-locked and\n+  don’t require per-swap host register/unregister.\n+\n+### 2) Unload = pointer swap (no D2H)\n+\n+- File: `comfy/model_patcher.py`\n+- When unloading to CPU, we try `comfy.pinned_memory.restore_from_pin(m)`:\n+  - If present, it swaps module parameters back to the CPU store (no copy).\n+  - Otherwise it falls back to `m.to(cpu)` once and then builds the store.\n+\n+### 3) H2D uses the store as the source\n+\n+- File: `comfy/ops.py`\n+- When offloading weights for compute on CUDA streams, we copy from the CPU\n+  store into the GPU cast buffer.\n+- If the store contains more than `(weight, bias)`, we only copy the required\n+  `(weight, bias)` prefix into the cast buffer.\n+\n+---\n+\n+## Why “pinned” can be dramatically faster (and sometimes slower)\n+\n+Pinned (page-locked) host memory allows the GPU to DMA directly at high\n+bandwidth and enables effective `non_blocking=True` copies. Pageable memory\n+often forces an extra staging copy into an internal pinned buffer and/or incurs\n+page-fault overhead, which can reduce effective H2D bandwidth by ~2–4×.\n+\n+However, **pinning/unpinning itself is expensive**:\n+\n+- `cudaHostRegister/Unregister` is not free (system calls + driver bookkeeping).\n+- Doing it thousands of times per prompt can dominate runtime and make the\n+  “pinned” configuration slower than “unpinned”.\n+\n+The patch here makes “pinned” behave as intended by pinning once (via the\n+allocator) and reusing that memory across swaps.\n+\n+---\n+\n+## Benchmark (Qwen workflow)\n+\n+Workflow: `user/default/workflows/qwen.json` (converted to API prompt).\n+\n+Driver script (no websocket dep):\n+\n+```bash\n+python script_examples/bench_qwen_api_poll.py --ui-workflow user/default/workflows/qwen.json\n+```\n+\n+Profiling runs here used `PYTHONPATH=/mnt/private/workspace/wzy/flat_slab` and:\n+\n+```bash\n+python -m comfy_profile.run_comfyui --run-name <name> --out-dir artifacts/profiling --disable-mmap\n+```\n+\n+### Observed prompt latency (RTX 4090, Feb 14 2026)\n+\n+Numbers below are **end-to-end per prompt** (polling `/history/{prompt_id}`).\n+Warmup includes first-time model load + compilation/caches.\n+\n+- Baseline + pinned (host register per swap)\n+  - warmup: ~47.1s\n+  - steady: ~16.1s, ~12.1s (avg ~14.1s)\n+- Baseline + unpinned (`--disable-pinned-memory`)\n+  - warmup: ~41.4s\n+  - steady: ~10.0s, ~9.7s (avg ~9.9s)\n+- Patched + pinned (persistent torch pinned store)\n+  - warmup: ~82.7s (one-time store build cost)\n+  - steady: ~10.0s, ~9.6s (avg ~9.8s)\n+- Patched + unpinned (`--disable-pinned-memory`)\n+  - warmup: ~59.2s\n+  - steady: ~11.3s, ~10.4s (avg ~10.9s)\n+\n+Takeaways:\n+\n+- Baseline “pinned” was slower because it spent significant time repeatedly\n+  registering/unregistering host memory.\n+- With a persistent pinned store, pinned improves steady-state latency and\n+  restores high H2D bandwidth.\n+\n+### H2D throughput (from profiler JSON)\n+\n+- Patched pinned:\n+  - `ops.cast_bias_weight>mm.cast_to_gathered`: ~62.25 GB / 2.67 s ≈ **23.3 GB/s**\n+- Patched unpinned:\n+  - `ops.cast_bias_weight>mm.cast_to_gathered`: ~61.34 GB / 6.64 s ≈ **9.2 GB/s**\n+\n+---\n+\n+## Future work ideas (not implemented here)\n+\n+- Avoid cold-start store build:\n+  - - **Patched + pinned（最终方案）**：稳态约 **9.8s**（10.0s、9.6s），warmup ~82.7s `data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md:94`
- Baseline + pinned：稳态约 **14.1s**（16.1s、12.1s），warmup ~47.1s `data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md:88`
- Baseline + unpinned：稳态约 **9.9s**（10.0s、9.7s），warmup ~41.4s `data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md:91`
- Patched + unpinned：稳态约 **10.9s**（11.3s、10.4s），warmup ~59.2s `data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md:97`

> AGENT

**Baseline vs Patched（做了哪些优化）**
- **持久化 CPU 权重 store**：在权重还在 CPU 时分配一块平坦 `uint8` store（可选 pinned），把模块的直接参数拷进 store 并让参数指向 store 视图；这样不再需要每次 swap 做 `cudaHostRegister/Unregister`。`data/comfyui/comfy/pinned_memory.py:14`
- **卸载时只做指针切换（无 D2H）**：卸载到 CPU 时优先 `restore_from_pin`，直接把参数指回 CPU store，VRAM 直接丢弃。`data/comfyui/comfy/pinned_memory.py:59`，`data/comfyui/comfy/model_patcher.py:803`
- **H2D 复制来源改为 store**：offload 计算时从 store 一次性拷到 GPU cast buffer；如果 store 比 `(weight,bias)` 大，只拷前缀。`data/comfyui/comfy/ops.py:242`
- **Baseline 行为差异**：原始“pinned”会频繁 host register/unregister，导致大量额外开销，这在 offload-heavy 场景会压低 e2e。`data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md:24`

**E2E 延迟（只看端到端耗时）**
- Baseline + pinned（频繁 host register）：warmup ~47.1s；稳态 ~16.1s / ~12.1s（均值 ~14.1s）`data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md:88`
- Baseline + unpinned：warmup ~41.4s；稳态 ~10.0s / ~9.7s（均值 ~9.9s）`data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md:91`
- **Patched + pinned（持久化 store）**：warmup ~82.7s；稳态 ~10.0s / ~9.6s（均值 ~9.8s）`data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md:94`
- Patched + unpinned：warmup ~59.2s；稳态 ~11.3s / ~10.4s（均值 ~10.9s）`data/comfyui/RAM_VRAM_OFFLOAD.md:97`

**推荐方案（只看 e2e）**
- **长期在线服务**：推荐 **Patched + pinned**，稳态 e2e 最优（~9.8s），且避免反复 host register 开销。
- **短任务/频繁冷启动**：若很在意 cold start，**Baseline + unpinned** 的 warmup 更短，稳态也接近（~9.9s）。

Keep a **persistent CPU weight store** per module (optionally pinned).\n     9\t2. On unload, **drop VRAM weights** and swap pointers back to the CPU store\n    10\t   (**no D2H copy**).\n    11\t\n    12\t---\n    13\t\n    14\t## What Changed\n    15\t\n    16\t### 1) Persistent CPU store (torch pinned allocator, not host-register)\n    17\t\n    18\t- File: `comfy/pinned_memory.py`\n    19\t- When a module is still on CPU, we allocate a flat `uint8` store via\n    20\t  `torch.empty(..., pin_memory=True)` (unless `--disable-pinned-memory`).\n    21\t- We copy the module’s **direct parameters** into this store once (CPU→CPU),\n    22\t  then point parameters to CPU **views** backed by the store.\n    23\t\n    24\tWhy this matters:\n    25\t\n    26\t- Baseline ComfyUI pins via `cudaHostRegister/Unregister` very frequently (per\n    27\t  swap). That overhead can be multiple seconds per prompt in heavy offload\n    28\t  workloads.\n    29\t- Pinned allocations from PyTorch’s pinned allocator are already page-locked and\n    30\t  don’t require per-swap host register/unregister.\n    31\t\n    32\t### 2) Unload = pointer swap (no D2H)\n    33\t\n    34\t- File: `comfy/model_patcher.py`\n    35\t- When unloading to CPU, we try `comfy.pinned_memory.restore_from_pin(m)`:\n    36\t  - If present, it swaps module parameters back to the CPU store (no copy).\n    37\t  - Otherwise it falls back to `m.to(cpu)` once and then builds the store.\n    38\t\n    39\t### 3) H2D uses the store as the source\n    40\t\n    41\t- File: `comfy/ops.py`\n    42\t- When offloading weights for compute on CUDA streams, we copy from the CPU\n    43\t  store into the GPU cast buffer.\n    44\t- If the store contains more than `(weight, bias)`, we only copy the required\n    45\t  `(weight, bias)` prefix into the cast buffer.\n    46\t\n    47\t---\n    48\t\n    49\t## Why “pinned” can be dramatically faster (and sometimes slower)\n    50\t\n    51\tPinned (page-locked) host memory allows the GPU to DMA directly at high\n    52\tbandwidth and enables effective `non_blocking=True` copies. Pageable memory\n    53\toften forces an extra staging copy into an internal pinned buffer and/or incurs\n    54\tpage-fault overhead, which can reduce effective H2D bandwidth by ~2–4×.\n    55\t\n    56\tHowever, **pinning/unpinning itself is expensive**:\n    57\t\n    58\t- `cudaHostRegister/Unregister` is not free (system calls + driver bookkeeping).\n    59\t- Doing it thousands of times per prompt can dominate runtime and make the\n    60\t  “pinned” configuration slower than “unpinned”.\n    61\t\n    62\tThe patch here makes “pinned” behave as intended by pinning once (via the\n    63\tallocator) and reusing that memory across swaps.\n    64\t\n    65\t---\n    66\t\n    67\t## Benchmark (Qwen workflow)\n    68\t\n    69\tWorkflow: `user/default/workflows/qwen.json` (converted to API prompt).\n    70\t\n    71\tDriver script (no websocket dep):\n    72\t\n    73\t```bash\n    74\tpython script_examples/bench_qwen_api_poll.py --ui-workflow user/default/workflows/qwen.json\n    75\t```\n    76\t\n    77\tProfiling runs here used `PYTHONPATH=/mnt/private/workspace/wzy/flat_slab` and:\n    78\t\n    79\t```bash\n    80\tpython -m comfy_profile.run_comfyui --run-name <name> --out-dir artifacts/profiling --disable-mmap\n    81\t```\n    82\t\n    83\t### Observed prompt latency (RTX 4090, Feb 14 2026)\n    84\t\n    85\tNumbers below are **end-to-end per prompt** (polling `/history/{prompt_id}`).\n    86\tWarmup includes first-time model load + compilation/caches.\n    87\t\n    88\t- Baseline + pinned (host register per swap)\n    89\t  - warmup: ~47.1s\n    90\t  - steady: ~16.1s, ~12.1s (avg ~14.1s)\n    91\t- Baseline + unpinned (`--disable-pinned-memory`)\n    92\t  - warmup: ~41.4s\n    93\t  - steady: ~10.0s, ~9.7s (avg ~9.9s)\n    94\t- Patched + pinned (persistent torch pinned store)\n    95\t  - warmup: ~82.7s (one-time store build cost)\n    96\t  - steady: ~10.0s, ~9.6s (avg ~9.8s)\n    97\t- Patched + unpinned (`--disable-pinned-memory`)\n    98\t  - warmup: ~59.2s\n    99\t  - steady: ~11.3s, ~10.4s (avg ~10.9s)\n   100\t\n   101\tTakeaways:\n   102\t\n   103\t- Baseline “pinned” was slower because it spent significant time repeatedly\n   104\t  registering/unregistering host memory.\n   105\t- With a persistent pinned store, pinned improves steady-state latency and\n   106\t  restores high H2D bandwidth.\n   107\t\n   108\t### H2D throughput (from profiler JSON)\n   109\t\n   110\t- Patched pinned:\n   111\t  - `ops.cast_bias_weight>mm.cast_to_gathered`: ~62.25 GB / 2.67 s ≈ **23.3 GB/s**\n   112\t- Patched unpinned:\n   113\t  - `ops.cast_bias_weight>mm.cast_to_gathered`: ~61.34 GB / 6.64 s ≈ **9.2 GB/s**\n   114\t\n   115\t---\n   116\t\n   117\t## Future work ideas (not implemented here)\n   118\t\n   119\t- Avoid cold-start store build:\n   120\t  - Load weights directly into pinned store (no extra CPU→CPU copy), or\n   121\t  - Use one-time `cudaHostRegister` (no per-swap register/unregister), if stable.\n   122\t- Pack larger shards (dtype-wise slabs) to reduce copy call count further.\n   123\t- Better eviction policy for pinned stores when running multiple large models.\n   124", "wall_time": "0.0504 seconds"}
